I made you a pilot. I gave you purpose. I gave you everything you ever wanted. What did he give you that I could not?''"
"''A family.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora|audio=TiernyTamGaveYou-TheEscape.flac|{{Resistance|The Escape (episode)}}}} '''Tierny''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as an [[agent]] in the [[First Order Security Bureau]] during the [[Cold War|conflict]] [[First Order-Resistance War|between]] the [[First Order]] and the [[Resistance]]. In [[34 ABY]], she was sent to the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' on the [[planet]] [[Castilon]] to root out the Resistance presence on the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]]. While there, she interrogated the [[Technician|mechanic]] [[Tamara Ryvora]], whose colleagues [[Kazuda Xiono]] and [[Jarek Yeager]] worked for the Resistance. After presenting herself as caring and sympathetic, Tierny manipulated Ryvora into joining the First Order as a [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|pilot]] and betraying Xiono and Yeager, making the mechanic believe they never cared about her. Tierny, [[Commander]] [[Pyre]], and Ryvora fled the ''Colossus'' before its jump to [[hyperspace]], boarding the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'', where Ryvora was accepted as a First Order [[cadet]]. Over the following [[Standard month|months]], Tierny and Pyre [[Hunt for the Colossus|pursued]] the ''Colossus'' across [[the galaxy]]. Using [[Tam's comlink|Ryvora's comlink]], they tracked the [[Space station|station]] to the planet [[D'Qar]] but were [[Skirmish over D'Qar|unable]] to prevent the platform from escaping. Tierny devised a plot to have an [[engineer]]—[[Nenavakasa Nalor]]—[[Sabotage of the Colossus|sabotage]] the ''Colossus'', but it proved unsuccessful. After [[Skirmish by a signal beacon|tracing]] the station's [[signal beacon]] through [[Realspace|space]], the ''Thunderer'' again failed to capture the ''Colossus'' but instead captured a [[Resistance pilot]]—[[Venisa Doza]]—who had been trying to rendezvous with the refueling station. Although Doza [[Escape of Venisa Doza|escaped]] detainment, Tierny continued to pursue the ''Colossus'' alongside Pyre. On the planet [[Varkana]], the agent [[torture]]d the ''Colossus'' residents Yeager and [[pirate]] [[Synara San]] to acquire the station's location. However, before the [[First Order officer|officer]] could question the pair further, she was knocked out by the Resistance [[BB-series astromech droid|droid]] [[CB-23]], and they [[Rescue of Norath Kev|fled]] the world with Xiono and the Resistance [[spy]] [[Norath Kev]]. Next, following a report from a [[Unidentified Spider probe droid|probe droid]], Tierny and Pyre traveled aboard the ''Thunderer'' to meet with the ''Colossus'' on the planet [[Aeos Prime]], where the station had been attempting to settle permanently. Upon again [[Battle of Aeos Prime|failing]] to capture the station, she [[Blockade of Dantooine|encountered]] the Resistance and some ''Colossus'' [[Ace Squadron]] [[pilot]]s over the planet [[Dantooine]], who were escorting [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] of recruits offworld. Although the First Order only destroyed [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|one]] of the three escaping [[shuttle]]s, Tierny comforted Ryvora about the failure and promoted her to [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|squadron]] [[Squadron commander|leader]]. Afterward, the agent and Pyre returned to Aeos Prime to lead its [[Suppression of the Aeos system|bombardment]]. Ryvora eventually grew disillusioned with the First Order and chose to [[Desertion|defect]], taking her [[comlink]] from [[Tierny's office]] and meeting with her former colleagues on Castilon. After the First Order captured Ryvora and the colleagues she had been intending to meet—Yeager, Xiono, and CB-23—Tierny confronted her about the [[Treason|betrayal]]. The ''Thunderer'' then traveled to the [[Barabesh system]] to [[Battle of Barabesh|confront]] the ''Colossus'' again, having learned its location from the First Order pilot [[Jace Rucklin]]. However, as the ''Colossus'' successfully repelled the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} attacks, Tierny was [[Death penalty|executed]] for her failure by [[Supreme Leader]] [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren]]. ==Biography== ===Endeavor on Castilon=== ====Arrival on the platform==== {{Quote|This is not what you expected, is it? I'm not a monster, Tamara. Our goal is galactic peace through absolute order. Nothing more. I know how hard it must be for you to trust anyone right now.''"
"''Look, this is all a big misunderstanding. Yeager, Neeku, Kaz, they're not spies.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora, in the Aces' Lounge|audio=TamTiernyAcesLounge-Descent.flac|}} The [[human]] [[Gender|female]] Tierny lived during the [[New Republic Era|reign]] of the [[New Republic]]. For some [[time]],{{Resistance|Rebuilding the Resistance}} she scraped her way through life to survive and eventually joined the [[First Order]], having believed she was meant for a bigger purpose. Eventually, she became an [[agent]] in the secretive''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' [[First Order Security Bureau]] by the time of the [[Cold War|conflict]] [[First Order-Resistance War|between]] the First Order and the [[Resistance]]. During her service, Tierny became known for her aggressive and manipulative interrogation tactics, sometimes lulling her targets into a false sense of security. In [[34 ABY]],{{ResistanceDate|1|19}} the First Order [[Occupation of the Colossus|occupied]] the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|supertanker fuel depot]] ''[[Colossus]]'' on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]][[Star Wars Galaxy Map (poster)|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map poster]] [[planet]] [[Castilon]]. While there, [[Commander]] [[Pyre]] led his [[Colossus garrison|garrison's]] [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtroopers]] to arrest [[Team Fireball|Team ''Fireball'']] upon the revelation that the crew's [[Fireball|namesake racer]] had been used by Resistance members [[Mission to the Dassal system|trespassing]] in the First Order–controlled [[Sector Epsilon 51-3]] in the [[Unknown Regions]]' [[Dassal system]].{{SW|url=news/star-wars-inside-intel-starkiller-base|text=''Star Wars'' Inside Intel: Starkiller Base|int=Star Wars Inside Intel}} Although the [[Technician|mechanics]] [[Jarek Yeager]], [[Kazuda Xiono]], and [[Neeku Vozo]] escaped, one of the team's members, the mechanic [[Tamara Ryvora]], was captured. Tierny was sent to the ''Colossus'' to interrogate Ryvora and root out any Resistance presence, and Pyre prepared for the agent's arrival. [[File:TiernyRyvora-Descent.jpg|left|thumb|300px|Tierny escorted Ryvora away from Doza's office aboard the ''Colossus''.]] After landing her [[Pyre's ship|shuttle]], Tierny was met by Pyre and the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Captain]] [[Imanuel Doza]], and they traveled to [[Doza's office]] in [[Doza Tower]]. When Ryvora was brought into the office by stormtroopers, Tierny immediately approached her in a friendly and comforting fashion,{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance/descent-episode-gallery|text="Descent" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 4}} ordering the mechanic's [[Stuncuffs|binders]] removed. When Doza began interfering in the agent's questioning of Ryvora, the First Order agent escorted the confused mechanic to the [[Aces' Lounge]], where they could converse privately. During the conversation, Tierny attempted to positively frame the First Order's quest for [[The galaxy|galactic]] peace by using her well-honed guile to manipulate Ryvora's feelings toward her friends. Afterward, the agent revealed to Ryvora that her colleague Xiono was not who he had claimed to be—he was actually a former [[New Republic Defense Fleet|New Republic Navy]] [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] and a member of one of the [[Core Worlds]] planet [[Hosnian Prime]]'s wealthiest [[Xiono family|families]] who had been recruited into the Resistance. Having believed Xiono was from a poor background, Ryvora was shocked to learn more about his past when the agent gave her a [[datapad]] containing his service record. When the ''Colossus''{{'s}} [[Alarm system|alarms]] blared shortly afterward and the [[Supertanker fuel depot|station]] began to shake, Tierny left the lounge to investigate, placing Ryvora under two stormtroopers' guard. ====A suspicious sinking==== {{Quote|Frankly, Pyre…I find the timing of this 'accident' suspicious, especially with three Resistance agents running amok.''"
"''I was thinking the exact same thing, Tierny.|Tierny and Pyre, in Doza's office|audio=TiernyPyreSuspicious-Descent.flac| }} [[File:TiernyPyreDoza-Descent.png|right|thumb|300px|Pyre, Tierny, and Doza watched as the ''Colossus'' sunk into Castilon's seas.]] The agent returned to Doza's office, demanding that the captain inform her of what was happening. Doza, who had secretly been collaborating with Team ''Fireball'' members Yeager and Xiono to [[Mission to contact the Resistance|sink]] the ''Colossus'' to sabotage the First Order's communications blackout and contact the Resistance by accessing the [[transmitter]] outside Doza Tower, lied and claimed that a [[reactor]] malfunction must have been occurring. At Pyre's directive, Doza began closing the ''Colossus''{{'s}} emergency hatches to prevent the [[Space station|station]] from flooding. The trio watched from Doza's office as the refueling station slowly sank into Castilon's [[Ocean|seas]], leaving only Doza Tower above [[water]]. Tierny then conversed with Pyre, with both agreeing that the timing of the alleged reactor failure was suspicious, given that Resistance [[Spy|spies]] were still running loose on the ''Colossus''. After a [[Unidentified First Order man|man]]{{Resistance|Descent (episode)}} {{Subtitles|Disney+}} informed Tierny and Pyre via [[comlink]] that the First Order's [[Jammer|jamming signal]] was not operational, Doza suggested water damage as a probable cause. However, Tierny looked out the [[Viewport|window]] and noticed that the transmitter was above the water line, causing Pyre to leave to deal with the situation. Although Xiono and his [[BB-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[CB-23]] escaped after contacting the Resistance, Yeager was captured by stormtroopers while stalling so the pair could flee. ====Recruiting Tam Ryvora==== {{Quote|I want to make you an offer, Tamara. I don't want to see your potential wasted on this platform for the rest of your life.''"
"''What kind of offer?''"
"''You've always dreamed of becoming a successful pilot, have you not?''"
"''I mean, yeah. I've always felt at home in the sky.''"
"''Well, if you come with me, I believe you will find the First Order can make those dreams a reality.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora|audio=TiernyTamOffer-NoEscapePart1.flac|{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 1}}}} [[File:RyvoraTiernyYeager-NoEscapePart1.png|left|thumb|300px|Tierny showed Ryvora evidence of Yeager's Resistance ties.]] Seeing Ryvora as a potential asset to the First Order, the agent decided to recruit her to their side by presenting herself as a kind and understanding alternative to her former colleagues.{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance/no-escape-part-1-episode-gallery|text="No Escape: Part 1" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 3}} Tierny treated Ryvora to a sumptuous meal in the Aces' Lounge, telling her she deserved more than the ''Colossus'' had to offer. The agent further sought to sully Ryvora's opinions of Xiono and Yeager, expounding on their connections to the Resistance with recorded evidence of their actions. When Ryvora responded that Yeager was only trying to protect Xiono by pretending to be a spy, Tierny countered that the recording showed both were Resistance operatives and that she could not trust the former because he had kept secrets from her. [[File:TiernyRecruitsRyvora-NoEscapePart1.png|right|thumb|300px|Tierny recruited Ryvora into the First Order.]] The mechanic was troubled by the agent's claim, at first disbelieving the evidence provided, but eventually coming to see the agent as a guide and interpreting her evidence as compelling.{{SW|url=news/christopher-sean-and-suzie-mcgrath-interview-star-wars-resistance|text=Christopher Sean and Suzie McGrath on Saying Goodbye to ''Star Wars Resistance''}} Shortly afterward, Tierny escorted Ryvora through a corridor on the ''Colossus'', and they encountered a captive Yeager as they passed by. Despite Yeager warning the mechanic that the First Order was manipulating her, the agent convinced Ryvora to continue following her to Doza Tower. Tierny stoked the mechanic's resentment toward Xiono by suggesting that he was deceptive. Aware of Ryvora's desire to become a [[pilot]], Tierny offered her a place with the First Order by claiming they could train her to reach her potential. ====Fleeing the refueling station==== {{Quote|You're losing control of this station, Pyre. To ensure the safety of everyone on board, I suggest you call in reinforcements. I'm taking Tamara off-world, back to base.''"
"''Perhaps reinforcements are the right idea. If we can't raise this station, we'll have to resort to a more aggressive solution.|Tierny and Pyre, aboard the ''Colossus''|audio=TiernyPyreControl-NoEscapePart2.flac|{{Resistance|No Escape: Part 2}}}} [[File:PyreRyvoraTierny-NoEscapePart2.png|thumb|left|300px|Tierny and Pyre left the ''Colossus'' with Ryvora.]] When Xiono and his colleagues—[[Team Colossus|Team ''Colossus'']]—flooded the ''Colossus'' as part of a plot to [[Battle of Castilon|expel]] [[First Order military|First Order forces]], Tierny and Pyre were present in Doza Tower. Upon a stormtrooper informing them that they had lost five more [[trooper]]s, Tierny advised Pyre to bring reinforcements and told him that she was taking Ryvora offworld. Not wanting to lose control of the station, Pyre advocated for a "more aggressive solution" if the station could not be raised but also agreed on taking the mechanic off the platform. After the First Order officers left Doza's office, Yeager—who had been secretly listening to their conversation while hiding in the room with Doza—resolved to not let Ryvora leave the ''Colossus''. At Doza Tower's landing platform, Tierny and Pyre accompanied Ryvora aboard a waiting [[Upsilon-class command shuttle|''Upsilon''-class command shuttle]]. While there, Xiono and Yeager tried to convince Ryvora not to leave with the First Order, but she was still bitter towards them for keeping secrets from her and felt he had made her false promises as a cover for his Resistance operations. Exploiting the conflict between Ryvora, Xiono, and Yeager, Tierny claimed that the First Order was giving Ryvora protection and a new purpose. As the ''Colossus'' fired up its [[hyperdrive]] to flee Castilon, CB-23 squirted [[oil]], causing four stormtroopers at the top of Doza Tower to fall onto the landing platform. Meanwhile, Xiono and Yeager eliminated the other nearby stormtroopers. Tierny and Pyre engaged in a firefight with Xiono while waiting for their [[transport]] to arrive, and then they evacuated Ryvora from the platform alongside a stormtrooper. As the ''Colossus'' rocketed into [[Realspace|space]], the First Order dispatched [[Major]] [[Elrik Vonreg]]'s [[Elrik Vonreg's squadron|squadron]] and a [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]] to destroy the ''Colossus''. However, the station escaped into [[hyperspace]]. ===Pursuing the ''Colossus''=== ====Onboarding a new cadet==== {{Quote|I'm an excellent pilot, and I want to use those skills in service of a cause I believe in.''"
"''I believe you, Tamara. But if you are to rise in the ranks as one of the best, I will require your total cooperation.''"
"''I understand.''"
"''So you will help us locate the ''Colossus''?''"
"''I will.''"
"''Even though you know that might put your friends in jeopardy?''"
"''They're not my friends anymore. I've made my choice.|Tamara Ryvora and Tierny, aboard the ''Thunderer''|audio=TiernyTam-IntoTheUnknown.flac|{{Resistance|Into the Unknown}}}} [[File:TiernyRyvora-IntoTheUnknown.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tierny questioned Ryvora on her loyalty to the First Order, ensuring she would be willing to help hunt the ''Colossus''.]] After boarding the First Order ''Resurgent''-class [[Star Destroyer]] ''[[Thunderer]]'',''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Pyre and Tierny reported to Captain [[Phasma]] on the ''Colossus''{{'s}} whereabouts, assuring her that the refueling station [[Hunt for the Colossus|would soon]] be in the First Order's grasp. Despite Tierny's confidence in their success, Phasma indicated to the pair that if they could not control the station, then they should destroy it, or she would personally see to their [[Death penalty|execution]]. After the conversation, Ryvora was brought to meet with Tierny and Pyre, with the latter indicating that they were eager to hear any information she had to share about her former colleagues. The mechanic told the First Order operatives what she knew of Xiono and Yeager's association with the Resistance but eventually insisted she had told them everything she was aware of. After promising her loyalty to the First Order and agreeing to help hunt down the ''Colossus'', Ryvora was made a First Order [[cadet]] by Pyre and Tierny. Although they dismissed the cadet—now given the [[callsign]] DT-533—to acquire her uniform, Tierny continued to doubt Ryvora's loyalty. [[File:TiernyPyreRucklinRyvora-AQuickSalvageRun.png|thumb|left|300px|Tierny thanked Ryvora for turning in her comlink, which allowed the First Order to trace the ''Colossus'' to D'Qar.]] When Ryvora received a message from Xiono on her [[Tam's comlink|personal comlink]], she turned the device over to Tierny and Pyre to show her loyalty to the First Order after being persuaded to do so by fellow recruited cadet and former ''Colossus'' resident [[Jace Rucklin]]. The agent was pleased with the cadet's volunteering of information, giving the comlink to Pyre to use. The First Order traced the comlink's signal to the former Resistance{{Resistance|A Quick Salvage Run}} planet [[D'Qar]], which had been the site of a recent [[Battle of D'Qar|battle]] between the First Order and the main [[Resistance navy|Resistance fleet]]. Tierny deduced that the ''Colossus''{{'s}} crew were unaware of what had transpired and traveled to the location to rendezvous with the rest of the Resistance. Aboard the ''Thunderer'', she traveled to the world to find the ''Colossus'' stranded amongst the debris over D'Qar, unable to make the jump to hyperspace, as the crew had initially planned to refuel at the [[Resistance base]]. With no other options, Xiono led a team to [[Skirmish over D'Qar|salvage]] [[Coaxium|hyperfuel]] from the ruined [[Mandator IV-class Siege Dreadnought|''Mandator'' IV-class Siege Dreadnought]] ''[[Fulminatrix]]''. The ''Thunderer'' arrived while the Resistance cell was still aboard the wreckage, and Tierny launched an attack on the ''Colossus''; thanks to intelligence provided by an [[Unidentified First Order lieutenant (Thunderer)|officer]], her forces opened fire on what remained of the First Order [[Star Dreadnought]]. Doza deployed the [[Ace Squadron|Aces]] to counter the offensive, aiming to protect both his space station and Xiono's team amidst their coaxium extraction effort. Tierny watched the space battle from the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]], eventually witnessing a heavily damaged ''Colossus'' jump to hyperspace once Xiono's team returned to the station with the needed coaxium fuel. The agent asked Ryvora if she would continue to inform them of any future attempts to contact her by her former colleagues, to which the latter agreed. Although Pyre felt that the cadet should be firmly conditioned to ensure her loyalty to the First Order, Tierny disagreed, believing that Ryvora's state at the time would better help them find the ''Colossus''.{{SW|url=a-quick-salvage-run-episode-gallery|text="A Quick Salvage Run" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}} The agent later stored the cadet's comlink in her [[Tierny's office|office]] aboard the ''Thunderer''. ====Plot with an engineer==== {{Quote|I wasn't sure your plan with the saboteur was going to work. But it seems to be going well.''"
"''It's nice of you to admit that I'm right. You'll learn to regret ever doubting me.''"
"''Heh. We'll see about that.|Pyre and Tierny|audio=TiernyPyre-TheEngineer.flac|{{Resistance|The Engineer}}}} [[File:TiernyPyre-TheEngineer.png|thumb|right|300px|Tierny and Pyre discussed the former's plan with the engineer to sabotage the ''Colossus''.]] Not long afterward, Tierny devised a plot to capture the ''Colossus'' in its damaged state. She hired the [[engineer]] [[Nenavakasa Nalor]] to track the refueling station in her [[Nena's ship|ship]] and board the station under the guise of helping them with repairs while secretly [[Saboteur|sabotaging]] the station. After accepting Tierny's offer of employment, Nalor traced the ''Colossus''{{'s}} path for a few [[Standard day|days]], eventually faking a [[distress signal]] that prompted Xiono and his colleague [[Synara San]] to bring her aboard the refueling station. Nalor [[Sabotage of the Colossus|sabotaged]] the station's systems using a [[k-spline]] component, broadcasted its location to the First Order, and reported back to Pyre so that he credited her account with [[Currency|payment]] for the endeavor while fleeing. Despite his initial doubts, Pyre was impressed that the agent's plan seemingly succeeded as the ''Thunderer'' arrived at the ''Colossus''{{'s}} location. However, Xiono and Vozo worked swiftly to reverse Nalor's damage to the station and successfully evacuated the ''Colossus'' from the area after getting its systems back online. When the commander pointed out that Nalor had failed to sabotage the station entirely, Tierny indicated that the First Order should [[Death|execute]] the engineer if the First Order ever found her again. ====Meeting a pilot==== {{Quote|You wanted to see me, Agent Tierny?''"
"''You were held captive by the prisoner, correct?''"
"''Yes. It was my fault she escaped.''"
"''Did the pilot reveal anything as to her identity?''"
"''No. Nothing.''"
"''We'll find out soon enough. The First Order has eyes everywhere. Security will want a full debriefing of your experience. I suggest you cooperate with their investigation.|Tamara Ryvora and Tierny, after Venisa Doza's escape|audio=TiernyTam-RendezvousPoint.flac|{{Resistance|Rendezvous Point (episode)}}}} [[File:TiernyHangarbay-RendezvousPoint.png|thumb|left|300px|Tierny on the ''Thunderer'', moving to confront captured Resistance pilot Venisa Doza]] While still hunting for the ''Colossus'', Tierny traveled aboard the ''Thunderer'' after [[Skirmish by a signal beacon|tracking]] the station's [[signal beacon]] to a location in space. The supertanker fuel depot fled after First Order forces began attacking, but a lone [[Resistance pilot]]—[[Venisa Doza]], who had been attempting to rendezvous with the ''Colossus''—entered the area from hyperspace, flying in her [[Venisa Doza's X-wing|X-wing]] with her [[astromech droid]], [[Torch]]. After Doza was caught in the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[tractor beam]], she was brought to the vessel's [[hangar]] and met Tierny, who asked about her identity. When the pilot refused to volunteer information, the agent ordered her to be taken into custody and her [[T-70 X-wing starfighter|ship's]] logs to be inspected for clues. A [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper 1 (Thunderer)|stormtrooper]] informed Tierny shortly afterward that the ship and Torch both appeared fried. Although stormtroopers tossed Torch into a junk pile, assuming the [[droid]] to be non-operable, the droid whirred back to life and [[Escape of Venisa Doza|rescued]] Doza from her cell. The Resistance pilot took Ryvora hostage while heading to the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} [[Bay 2 (Thunderer)|Bay 2]], attempting to convince her to [[Desertion|defect]] from the First Order by revealing her own identity as a member of the Doza family and a friend of Yeager. Doza [[stun]]ned the young cadet when she refused, and Tierny entered the hangar behind a contingent of troopers. After Torch used explosives to set a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter|TIE fighter]] [[Fire|aflame]], the agent realized the incident was a diversion providing cover for Doza's escape and ordered the area to be locked down. [[File:RyvoraTierny-RendezvousPoint.png|thumb|right|300px|Tierny and Ryvora discussed Venisa Doza's escape.]] The agent then indicated to nearby stormtroopers that they should shoot down a [[TIE series|TIE fighter]] taking off from the hangar, assuming the Resistance pilot was inside. However, Torch was piloting the craft as another diversion, letting the ship slowly get fired upon while his{{SW|url=rendezvous-point-episode-gallery|text=Rendezvous Point Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slides 8 and 11}} pilot boarded her [[X-wing starfighter|starfighter]]. As Tierny and the other First Order forces watched, Torch ejected from the damaged TIE and reconnected with Doza's vessel as it jumped into hyperspace. Shortly following the incident, Tierny asked to meet with Ryvora and verified that the cadet had been held captive by Doza during her escape. However, Ryvora lied to the agent, claiming that the pilot had not revealed her identity. While Tierny was skeptical of Ryvora's answers, she simply told the cadet to comply with her security debriefing. ====Confrontations with spies==== {{Quote|Our friend Kazuda Xiono was here. He acquired a binary deflector and then escaped capture.''"
"''Did DT-533 contact the spy?''"
"''She was reportedly with DT-798, who turned them in.''"
"''Interesting. If we play this right, Miss Ryvora will help us destroy the ''Colossus''.|Pyre and Tierny, after Xiono's theft on the ''Titan''|audio=TiernyPyre-StationToStation.flac|{{Resistance|Station to Station}}}} [[File:TiernyPyre-StationToStation.png|thumb|left|300px|Pyre contacted Tierny via hologram after the theft on the ''Titan''.]] The ''Colossus''—still fleeing from the First Order—desperately needed a [[trans-binary deflector]] replacement; failing to retrieve one would lead to the deaths of all on the station due to [[cosmic radiation]]. After Xiono and Vozo [[Infiltration of the Titan|stole]] one from the First Order supertanker fuel depot ''[[Titan]]'', Pyre informed Tierny via [[hologram]] from the ''Titan'' that the two ''Colossus'' residents had [[Thief|stolen]] the part. When the agent inquired if Ryvora had contacted her former colleagues, the commander indicated that she had not. Tierny considered the information, eventually reflecting that the new cadet would be the key to locating the ''Colossus''. After receiving a Resistance distress signal from{{Resistance|The Missing Agent}} the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] planet [[Varkana]], Xiono, Yeager, San, and CB-23 [[Rescue of Norath Kev|investigated]] the world while the ''Colossus'' remained in its [[Varkana system|star system]]. However, the group soon became trapped in the [[bounty hunter]] [[Ax Tagrin]]'s [[Dalkor Dagger|ship]] alongside the Resistance spy who had originally sent the distress signal—the [[Duros]] [[Norath Kev]]—whom Tagrin had captured earlier. After Tagrin informed Pyre of the Resistance group's capture aboard his ship, the commander and Tierny traveled aboard the ''Thunderer'' to Varkana and took a transport to land on Varkana.{{Resistance|Breakout}} While Xiono and Kev escaped the [[bounty]] hunter's custody, San, Yeager, and CB-23 were recaptured and escorted into the [[Vargo Spaceport]]'s main hangar to meet with Tierny and Pyre upon their arrival. ====Varkana interrogations==== {{Quote|Stop it. I said stop.''"
"''I'm surprised you care about this pirate, Yeager. How compassionate.''"
"''Unlike you, I'm a compassionate person.''"
"''Is that so? Funny, that's not how Tamara described you. But we'll get to that soon enough. First, shall we continue?|Jarek Yeager and Tierny, as the latter tortured him and Synara San|audio=TiernyYeager-Breakout.flac|}} [[File:TiernyYeagerSan-Breakout.png|thumb|right|300px|Tierny interrogated San and Yeager on Varkana.]] Tierny coldly{{SW|url=breakout-episode-gallery|text="Breakout" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} addressed Yeager by name, lamenting that their past meetings had been too brief for them to get acquainted, and she led him and San aboard a First Order shuttle with the help of two stormtroopers. While still docked in the hangar, the agent interrogated the pair using electric shocks in [[interrogation chair]]s, probing for the location of the ''Colossus''. When Yeager pleaded for her to stop harming San, she mocked him for his compassion for the pirate and confronted him for his treatment of Ryvora by keeping secrets from her. She then turned her attention on Yeager fully, electrocuting him as she repeatedly implored him to tell her his method of contacting Resistance [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and where else the Resistance was hiding throughout the [[galaxy]]. Although the mechanic insisted he did not know the information she was looking for, Tierny replied that he was lying, noting that Ryvora had told her about his past as a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. [[File:TiernyCB23-Breakout.png|thumb|left|300px|CB-23 knocked out Tierny after escaping from the First Order's restraints.]] Although the pair briefly argued over whether the First Order was manipulating the young cadet, Tierny was called away to help with an issue at [[console A2]] and remarked that she would finish her interrogation later. When San noted that the agent would not stop until she had her answers, the pair began considering ways of escaping. Tierny, who was helping Pyre and another stormtrooper crack the [[memory bank]]s of CB-23 from a console, watched as First Order [[Lieutenant]] [[Galek]] reported to Pyre that the ''Colossus'' had just left the Varkana system. As the agent looked on, CB-23 was then electrocuted by a [[Unidentified tech stormtrooper (Varkana)|tech stormtrooper]] in an attempt to get her to reveal the station's location. When that [[Tech stormtrooper|trooper]] succeeded in accessing the droid's main [[databank]]s, Tierny ordered them to drain all the information they could from CB-23 and destroy her afterward. After Tierny left the consoles, CB-23 knocked the stormtrooper unconscious and hooked into the system, frying the nearby equipment. The agent noticed the power shorting out as she walked away, and she headed back toward the area with her [[RK-3 blaster|blasters]] drawn. However, CB-23 swung down from the ceiling and knocked the agent out, leaving Tierny groaning on the floor. After Xiono and Kev freed San and Yeager, CB-23 rejoined the group, which fled Varkana aboard a [[Unidentified Star Commuter 2000|shuttle]] and eventually returned to the ''Colossus'' and escaped to hyperspace. ====Skirmish in the Aeos system==== {{Quote|It looks like our friend, Kazuda Xiono.''"
"''The ''Colossus'' can't be far behind.''"
"''Aeos Prime, home to a race of people who once collaborated with the Rebel Alliance.''"
"''We should have wiped them out before. But now we'll correct our mistake.|Tierny and Pyre, aboard the ''Thunderer''|audio=TiernyPyre-NoPlaceSafe.flac|{{Resistance|No Place Safe}}}} [[File:TiernyPyre-NoPlaceSafe.png|thumb|right|300px|Tierny and Pyre view a probe droid's image of Xiono taken in the Aeos system.]] Having been fleeing from the First Order for [[Standard month|months]], the ''Colossus'' eventually attempted to settle on the Outer Rim planet{{Resistance|The New World}} [[Aeos Prime]] permanently. However, the First Order tracked them to the world with a [[Unidentified Spider probe droid|probe droid's]] report, which contained an image of Xiono in the ''Fireball'' leaving Aeos Prime. Tierny pointed out the Resistance spy's identity to Galek and Pyre, having been informed of the development by a First Order bridge lieutenant. When the agent mentioned the world's [[Aeosian|population]] had once worked with the Rebel Alliance, Pyre declared that they should have wiped out the Aeosians when they [[Attack on Aeos Prime|attacked them]] in the past and ordered a course set for the [[Aeos system]]. Upon arrival, the ''Thunderer'' began [[Battle of Aeos Prime|attacking]] the ''Colossus'' as it attempted to flee to hyperspace. Tierny watched the battle progress from the ''Thunderer'', listening as Pyre directed their Star Destroyer to fire on the refueling station's [[engine]]s to take out their hyperdrive. Tierny was surprised when Ace Squadron attacked their much larger vessel head-on, considering the move foolish. While flying in [[Jarek Yeager's racer]], Xiono attempted an attack run on the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} bridge, firing a [[missile]] when in range. However, Ryvora's TIE [[Starfighter|fighter]] blocked the projectile while Tierny and Pyre watched, with the officers ducking to brace for impact in the moments prior. The ''Colossus'' continued to ascend into Aeos Prime's [[orbit]] and jumped to hyperspace as the agent looked on from the bridge. She remarked to Pyre that General [[Armitage Hux]] would not be pleased, though he replied that the general was not [[Ben Solo|whom]] he was concerned about. Afterward, Tierny and Galek visited Ryvora and congratulated her on her performance in the skirmish, promoting her to [[Second Squadron Commander|second squadron commander]]. ====Dantooine skirmish and revisiting Aeos Prime==== {{Quote|DT‐533. Even though this mission was a failure, one of the three Resistance shuttles was successfully destroyed under your command. I know you're upset. Understand that Lieutenant Galek died in service to the First Order and was a fine squadron commander, but her failure has now created opportunities for others. There is one less group of Resistance we have to worry about, thanks to you. DT‐533, you are now promoted to squadron leader.|Tierny promoting Ryvora after Galek's death in the Dantooine skirmish|audio=TamPromoted2-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} [[File:DantooineBriefing-RebuildingTheResistance.png|thumb|left|300px|Tierny was present at a briefing about Resistance activity on Dantooine.]] Not long after, aboard the ''Thunderer'', Tierny and Pyre briefed Galek and three First Order cadets on recent reports of Resistance activity near the Outer Rim planet [[Dantooine]], with Pyre ordering their vessel to set course for the world since the [[Unidentified First Order TIE squadron|TIE squadron]] patrolling that area had fallen out of contact. As the ''Thunderer'' jumped to hyperspace, Tierny continued surveying a holographic projection of Dantooine. Later, the agent asked Ryvora to meet with her in her office aboard the Star Destroyer and inquired how she was. As she fiddled with Ryvora's comlink—which the cadet had turned over to her previously—in her hands, the cadet eyed the device while insisting she was doing great due to her promotion as second [[squadron]] commander. Tierny admitted her past doubts about her but noted she was wise not to have been deceived by her former colleague Xiono. As the agent tucked the comlink into her desk's drawer, Ryvora took note of where she placed it. Tierny expounded on her life before the First Order to the young woman, explaining that she had brought the mechanic to join them because of her potential. The agent insisted that Ryvora must continue to surpass her expectations but eventually dismissed the cadet when Galek called for all squadrons to prepare for launch. Upon arriving at Dantooine, the ''Thunderer'' [[Blockade of Dantooine|engaged]] a contingent of Resistance escorts and Ace Squadron pilots protecting three [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] of Resistance recruits. Although Rucklin destroyed [[Shuttle two (Resistance)|one]] of the shuttles in the ensuing dogfight, Galek was killed in the skirmish, and the rest of the combatants escaped. Tierny later met with Ryvora and consoled her over the mission's failure and Galek's loss. The agent then promoted her to [[squadron commander]] for the successful destruction of one of the three shuttles during the endeavor under her command, noting that Galek's failure created the opportunity for her promotion. Despite Tierny's praise, Ryvora was troubled by the conflict between her moral compass and duties as part of the First Order.{{SW|url=news/how-star-wars-resistance-makes-the-first-order-conflict-personal|text=How ''Star Wars Resistance'' Makes the First Order Conflict Personal}} ====Meeting with a leader==== {{Quote|While—while its whereabouts are still unknown, we are already working on a solution to that problem, Supreme Leader.''"
"''Your list of failures is long, Agent Tierny. I will not suffer the existence of any Resistance cell, no matter how small. If you are not capable of dealing with them, then I will find someone who can.''
"''We understand, Supreme Leader.''"
"''Do you?|Tierny and Kylo Ren|audio=WeUnderstand-TheEscape.flac|}} [[File:DoYouUnderstand-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Kylo Ren made Tierny and Pyre turn their blasters on each other using the Force, threatening them to succeed in securing the ''Colossus''.]] Following the Dantooine endeavor, Tierny traveled to the Aeos system aboard the ''Thunderer''. In retaliation for having served as a sanctuary for the ''Colossus'', she and Pyre oversaw the [[suppression of the Aeos system]] with thirteen other ''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyers, [[Orbital bombardment|bombarding]] the planet and killing the Aeosians that had helped the Resistance. The pair then contacted General Hux via hologram from Tierny's office and reported the attack's completion. However, [[Supreme Leader]] Kylo Ren took Hux's place in the terminal's feed and berated both Tierny and Pyre for failing to find the ''Colossus''. Although Tierny attempted to appease the Supreme Leader, he did not accept her excuses and threatened to replace both officers if they could not complete their assigned objective; Ren [[Force power|used]] [[the Force]] to make them both draw their [[blaster]]s and aim them at each other, only letting them go after several moments. The impatient Supreme Leader warned them that he would not tolerate further failures, giving them only one more chance to find the ''Colossus''. Tierny and Pyre exited the office, resolved to double their efforts. Moments after their departure, Ryvora used the reprogrammed [[MSE-6 series repair droid]] [[5-L]] to sneak into the agent's office and take her comlink from the room's desk. After conversing with an [[First Order officer|officer]] to request a report, Tierny returned to her office as the cadet attempted to hide from her. The agent was distracted by 5-L's presence, allowing Ryvora to slip from the room as her superior asked the [[MSE series|droid]] whether it had completed the system upgrade. 5-L beeped at Tierny and hurried from the room, attracting her gaze as she left the room too and shut the door. ===Final encounter with the ''Colossus''=== ====Dealing with treachery==== {{Quote|I'd like to know what you're doing as well, Tamara.''"
"''Agent Tierny. I'm just preparing my TIE for the training session I'm leading.''"
"''I thought that was in Hangar D-13?''"
"''Operations must have moved it to a different hangar.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora, as the latter lied to her superior|audio=TiernyTamTrainingSession-TheEscape.flac|}} Ryvora sent a message in a [[mechanic's code]] to Xiono and Vozo, asking them to help her escape the First Order by meeting her on Castilon. Afterward, she changed the hangar bay launch location of her upcoming TIE fighter training station to a different hangar bay on the ''Thunderer''. Tierny met with the cadet and Rucklin as she prepared her ship, questioning why she had altered the location of her session. When Ryvora claimed that [[Security Operations|Operations]] must have moved it, Tierny ordered Rucklin to assist her, letting the pair go while watching them intensely. The pilots then went to the [[Tashtor sector]]—where Castilon was located—for their training session. [[File:TiernyPyreThunderer-TheEscape.png|thumb|left|300px|Tierny and Pyre are briefed on the flight plan deviation of Tamara Ryvora's squadron, discovering the recruit's First Order betrayal.]] A [[Unidentified First Order Special Forces pilot|First Order pilot]] aboard the ''Thunderer'' informed Tierny and Pyre that [[sensor]]s had indicated [[Galek's TIE fighter squadron|Ryvora's squadron]] had jumped to Castilon. The agent and commander shared a glance, with the latter commenting that the new squadron leader must have felt homesick. Tierny then left and went to her office, finding Ryvora's comlink missing from her desk, as she had stolen it earlier. The agent was disappointed with the betrayal—having thought she gave Ryvora both training and purpose in life{{EncyclopediaCite|Ace Squadron}}—and figured out the rest of the lieutenant's plan to defect.{{Databank|tam-ryvora|Tam Ryvora}} With this knowledge, the ''Thunderer'' traveled to Castilon to intercept the squadron leader. Eventually, the vessel captured her and those who had come to her aid—Xiono, Yeager, and CB-23—and Rucklin, catching their shuttle in a tractor beam. Tierny confronted Ryvora for her treachery, lamenting that she had had great potential. Although the agent expounded that the punishment for [[treason]] was death, the recruit claimed she was no longer afraid of her. Rucklin then revealed that the ''Colossus'' was in the Mid Rim's [[Barabesh system]] to Tierny and Pyre but was nonetheless led away from the scene by stormtroopers despite his claims of innocence. Xiono and Yeager, hiding in the hangar bay with the shuttle, ran away from the vessel as stormtroopers searched it. One [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper (Thunderer's hangar)|stormtrooper]] ran out of the captured ship, indicating to Tierny that it was set to [[Self-destruct mechanism|self-destruct]]. She then ordered nearby troopers to fall back but was not quick enough to escape the blast and was tossed to the floor. Alarms blared as Tierny rose shakily; she pulled out her [[Blaster pistol|blasters]] and began shooting at Xiono and Yeager. She directed the stormtroopers with her not to let them escape as she chased after the pair. ====Skirmishing in hyperspace==== {{Quote|Security, we have Resistance agents loose on this ship. Lock down all positions. Code Red.''"
"''Understood, Agent Tierny.|Tierny and a security worker, aboard the ''Thunderer''|audio=FOSecurityPersonnel-TheEscape.flac|}} [[File:TiernyXionoYeager-TheEscape.png|thumb|right|300px|Tierny engaged in a firefight with Xiono and Yeager aboard the ''Thunderer''.]] As the agent continued exchanging blaster fire with the Resistance combatants, Pyre ordered the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} command to travel to the Barabesh system. The commander eventually joined her, chasing Xiono and Yeager out of the hangar and behind a [[blast door]] as both sides shot at each other. After seeing them disappear behind the door, Tierny called an [[Unidentified First Order security personnel|individual]] working for the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} security and told them to issue a [[Code Red]] due to the Resistance agents loose on the vessel. They agreed to lock down all positions, responding affirmatively. Pyre informed Tierny that the ''Thunderer'' was on its way to the Barabesh system to confront the ''Colossus'', leaving nowhere for the station to hide. She retorted that they may both face the consequences if he was not right, stalking away from him. On the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} bridge, a [[Unidentified First Order stormtrooper (Thunderer's bridge)|stormtrooper]] informed Tierny and Pyre that Ryvora had escaped and joined Xiono and Yeager as they fled from First Order forces and were last seen in [[turbolift G-27]]. Meanwhile, the fugitives snuck to the engineering section of the Star Destroyer and transmitted a message to the ''Colossus'', warning their colleagues that the First Order was on its way. Pyre and his stormtroopers captured the group shortly afterward and brought them to face Tierny on the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} bridge. She commended the trio for their tenacity but stated the First Order would stamp out their resistance shortly. The agent then questioned Ryvora as to her reason for betraying the First Order. The mechanic firmly replied that Yeager had given her a family, which Tierny found distasteful. ====Death and defeat==== {{Quote|Supreme Leader, I have the Colossus within my grasp, but I need reinforcements.''"
"''To add to your failure?''"
"''No, I simply need support to—''"
"''The First Order does not tolerate the weak, Agent Tierny.''"
"''I understand.''"
"''Do you?''"
"''Yes, Supreme… Leader.|Tierny and Kylo Ren|audio=TiernyKyloRen-TheEscape.flac|}} Moments later, the ''Thunderer'' arrived in the Barabesh system close to the ''Colossus'', much to the horror of the captured trio on the bridge, who had hoped the refueling station had fled due to their sent warning. As Pyre ordered the First Order to [[Battle of Barabesh|attack]], Tierny mocked that the group could now watch their "family" perish from the Star Destroyer's bridge. A bridge lieutenant informed the agent and the commander that ''Colossus'' pilots were attacking their thrusters, to which the former insisted that their [[Deflector shield|shields]] could not be breached. At Tierny's directive, Pyre left the bridge to prepare a boarding party. [[File:NoMercyForTheWeak-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Kylo Ren used the Force to choke Tierny for her failures, unwilling to tolerate her excuses.]] Working in secret, CB-23 deactivated the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} deflector shields, and an [[officer]] on the bridge relayed the news to Tierny. She demanded that they be brought back online, but the lieutenant insisted that they could not. When a blast from an enemy combatant rocked the bridge, Tierny and her troopers stumbled to catch their balance. Yeager, Xiono, and Ryvora used their momentary distraction to take out the troopers, shoot at the agent, destroy the bridge's controls, and flee the ''Thunderer''. Tierny raised her blaster and moved to pursue them, but they made it safely behind a door before she could. While still on the bridge, Ren contacted Tierny via hologram, with the latter insisting she had the ''Colossus'' within her grasp but needed reinforcements. The furious Supreme Leader berated the agent for her failure, did not accept her excuses, and [[Force choke|choked]] her using the Force. Tierny struggled to breathe, grasping at her collar,{{SW|url=the-escape-part-2-episode-gallery|text="The Escape: Part 2" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 10}} until Ren eventually killed her. Ace Squadron then fired at the ''Thunderer''{{'s}} engines for the final time, causing the machinery to explode and cause a chain reaction—which killed all on board.''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' Not long after, in [[35 ABY]], the ''Colossus'' [[Citizens' Fleet|helped]]''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' the Resistance defeat the First Order and [[Sith Eternal]] [[Religion|cult's]] [[Sith Eternal military|forces]] at the [[Battle of Exegol]]. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|I admit, I had my doubts about you at first, but that changed when you turned this over to me. You were wise not to be deceived by Kazuda Xiono's lies. Those who betray us…''"
"''Become our enemy.''"
"''You know, I wasn't born into the First Order. For years, I scraped by under the rule of the New Republic. But I knew I was meant for more. I brought you here because I saw the same potential in you, and you've surpassed all my expectations.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora|audio=HadMyDoubts-RebuildingTheResistance.flac|}} Tierny had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, dark skin, and a scar on her jaw. She kept her black [[hair]] in a complex knotted updo to maintain her curls.{{SW|url=news/cosplay-command-center-resistance|text=Cosplay Command Center, Part 1: Dressing the ''Resistance'' for ''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago}} Having struggled to survive during the time of the New Republic, Tierny hoped to restore peace to the galaxy through absolute order. The intimidating{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-intel|text=Mission Briefing: ''Star Wars Resistance'' Intel to Prepare You for the Season Finale}} agent was a staunch believer in ruling with an iron fist, having little mercy for those who disagreed with the goals of the First Order{{Topps|set=2020 Topps Women of Star Wars|cardname=#3: Agent Tierny|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/216003/cid/14374496/2020-Topps-Women-of-Star-Wars-3-Agent-Tierny|nobackup=1}} and considering it her main priority to root out all forms of opposition with laser-like precision. She felt treason to her organization was one of the worst crimes and was willing to order the execution of those who failed in their duties. Although Tierny maintained a collection of blasters in her office's display cases, she otherwise held no interest in art.{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-rebuilding-the-resistance-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Rebuilding the Resistance" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} Pyre and Tierny shared a workable affinity despite occasionally being skeptical of each other's methods. Some of Pyre's failures resulted in Tierny having more power at her rank than she normally would. Often, the commander was inclined to listen to Tierny's suggestions, in the hopes of avoiding Kylo Ren's further ire.{{WookYouTube|ML1nYpSU0d0|Wookieepedia Interviews - Brandon Auman}} [[File:TiernyConfrontation-TheEscape.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Tierny detested those opposing the First Order, wanting to exact any revenge she could on them.]] The agent viewed Ryvora as having great potential and saw a lot of herself reflected in the mechanic, wanting her to rise in the First Order's ranks and put her skills to use. By presenting herself as a sharp contrast to Pyre's aggressive stormtroopers, the agent used her persuasion skills to sow a wedge between Ryvora and her colleagues Yeager and Xiono, claiming that they had withheld information from her because they did not trust her. With Ryvora troubled by the news, Tierny succeeded in manipulating her into joining the First Order and becoming a cadet—while also willingly giving up information on her former colleagues—including turning her comlink over to her and Pyre. The agent continued being invested in the cadet's progress within the First Order and was proud when she performed well in skirmishes, issuing her both of her promotions—first to second squadron commander and later to squadron commander after Galek's death. She made an effort to ensure her protégé was doing well, taking time to meet with her in her office. Meanwhile, the agent expressed sharp derision for Ryvora's former father figure, Yeager, and how she felt he had treated the mechanic. Tierny expressed a sense of betrayal when Ryvora defected from the First Order, not understanding the mechanic's attachment to her "family" from the ''Colossus''. She enjoyed exacting revenge on enemies of the First Order, pleased at the concept of making Yeager, Ryvora, and Xiono watch the ''Thunderer'' destroy the ''Colossus'' in the Barabesh system. ==Skills and abilities== {{Dialogue|Tierny|Retrieve her flight data recorder. Perhaps where you've been will tell us more about who you are.|Stormtrooper|Both the system and her droid have been fried. Looks like sabotage.|Venisa Doza|Huh. How did that happen?|Tierny|We have other ways of getting information out of you. Take her to the detention bay.|attr=Tierny, a stormtrooper, and Venisa Doza|audio=TiernyVenisa-RendezvousPoint.flac|src=}} [[File:TiernyAimingBlaster-Descent.png|thumb|left|300px|Tierny was well-trained in combat while serving as a First Order agent.]] As a specially trained weapons expert and intelligence agent, Tierny had access to information on enemies of the First Order, including Xiono and Yeager's backgrounds. The agent was a master manipulator, preferring to lure her targets into a false sense of security. She prided herself on her methods and was able to quickly shift between an icy demeanor and a caring facade. Although she did not often resort to aggressive tactics, the formidable{{SW|url=news/12-highlights-from-the-star-wars-resistance-season-two-trailer|text=12 Highlights from the ''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two Trailer}} First Order agent engaged combatively with Resistance agents, including when she tortured Yeager and San on Varkana during an interrogation. During her First Order service, Tierny proved capable of wielding twin blasters against enemy combatants. ==Equipment== {{Quote|Kazuda hails from one of the wealthiest families on Hosnian Prime.''"
"''What? Wealthy? No, Kaz is just—''"
"''A pilot in the New Republic Navy, who was recruited to serve in the Resistance. Here, maybe his service record will help convince you.|Tierny and Tamara Ryvora, with the former presenting her datapad to the mechanic|audio=TiernyKazServiceRecord-Descent.flac|}} [[File:Tierny-BravuraScumAndVillainy.png|thumb|right|200px|Tierny in uniform]] As an agent of the First Order Security Bureau, Tierny wore a uniform designed by herself due to having no standard [[Clothing|uniform]]. She donned a ribbed, long-sleeved gray undersuit that featured extra knee padding and the inscription "FOSB" in the [[Aurebesh]] [[Writing|alphabet]].{{SW|url=star-wars-resistance-descent-concept-art-gallery|text="Descent" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slide 2}} Over this, she wore a fitted black chest armor piece alongside black shoulder pauldrons featuring the [[First Order insignia]] in white. Tierny carried standard First Order–issued code cylinders on a gray-and-black utility belt, two black holsters holding two black RK-3 blasters, and a sharply angled black [[helmet]] with a facial opening. She also wore gray [[glove]]s with black paneling, tall black boots, and gray pants with knee openings over her undersuit. When she was sent to the ''Colossus'' on Castilon, Tierny used an ''Upsilon''-class command shuttle and had access to a datapad that was able to display holograms. As she and Pyre tracked the ''Colossus'' across the galaxy, they both held command over the ''Thunderer''. While on Varkana, Tierny used two electric interrogation chairs to question Yeager and San. Tierny's office aboard the ''Thunderer'' featured two transparent, illuminated cases displaying several of her weapons, which were mounted to two opposing walls. The collection included five bladed weapons, four [[rifle]]s, and one blaster.{{SW|url=rebuilding-the-resistance-concept-art-gallery|text="Rebuilding the Resistance" Concept Art Gallery}} {{C|Slides 11 and 12}} The office's desk in the center of the room also featured storage compartments. ==Behind the scenes== ===Milestones=== {{Quote|By the time we get to Chicago, fans will have been more formally introduced to Tierny, a First Order security agent first glimpsed in the mid-season trailer.|Amy Beth Christenson|}} [[File:Tierny-ConceptArt.png|thumb|right|150px|Tierny, as first depicted on StarWars.com]] Tierny first appeared in "[[Descent (episode)|Descent]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'',{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} which aired on [[March 3]], [[2019]].{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}} Prior to the episode's release, she appeared unidentified in a mid-season trailer released on [[January 9]] of the same year.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-two-confirmed-mid-season-one-trailer-debuts|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two Confirmed, Mid-Season One Trailer Debuts}} Tierny was first identified by name in the [[StarWars.com]] article "[https://web.archive.org/web/20230607221326/https://www.starwars.com/news/cosplay-command-center-resistance Cosplay Command Center, Part 1: Dressing the ''Resistance'' for Star Wars Celebration Chicago]," written by [[Kristin Baver]] after interviewing ''Star Wars Resistance'' art director [[Amy Beth Christenson]]. Christenson briefly explained the new character's background and gave cosplay ideas for her costume for the upcoming [[Celebration Chicago]] convention, noting that fans would have been properly introduced to the agent by the time of the event, which began on [[April 11]], 2019.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-celebration-is-heading-to-chicago-and-the-star-wars-show-has-the-details|text=''Star Wars'' Celebration is Heading to Chicago and ''The Star Wars Show'' has the Details}} A card of a [[Xi-class light shuttle|''Xi''-class light shuttle]] on Castilon—noted to be transporting Tierny—was included in the ''[[Hotshots and Aces II Reinforcements Pack]]'' for [[Atomic Mass Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Second Edition]]'' ship-to-ship combat game,{{FFGXW2|set=Hotshots and Aces II Reinforcements Pack|cardname=Agent Tierny}} which was released on [[November 25]], [[2022]].{{Asmodee|subdomain=shop|url=star-wars-x-wing-2nd-ed-5-hot-shots-1-aces-ii-swz97en|text=Star Wars X-Wing 2nd Ed: Hot Shots & Aces II Reinforcements Pack}} However, Tierny uses other types of vessels during her arrival on Castilon and departure shortly afterward in ''Star Wars Resistance''. ===Portrayal=== {{Quote|I think that's, that's one of my favorite things about ''Resistance'' is the way they develop the characters from the beginning and throughout. I mean it's, it's masterfully done and I think that's why you've, you know, we all, we all feel that connection. ''[…]'' Just as a fan and watching it and getting to be a part of it as Tierny, like, it really, that really moved me. And you know you mentioned diversity—the fact that, you know, there's two women of color and that's, you know, Tierny and, you know Tierny and Tam and it's like—that's the, that's, that's amazing for me.|Sumalee Montano|audio=Tierny-SumaleeMontano.flac|{{YouTube|video=9G5zKfAoFPI|text=Interview: Sumalee Montano - Voice of Agent Tierny on Star Wars Resistance|channel=@FriendsOfTheForce|name=[[Friends of the Force]]|date=2020-05-25}}}} [[File:SumaleeMontano.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Sumalee Montano, Tierny's voice actor]] Tierny was voiced by [[Sumalee Montano]], a voice actor who had previously worked on [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] projects, including voicing the [[Force Adept]] [[Lashowe]] in the [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and portraying {{TORcite|type=other|exp=kotfe|Credits}} the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]]''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] in the [[2011]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as well as working on the current [[canon]]'s 2019 video game ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' as the [[Partisans]] lieutenant [[Mari Kosan]]. On [[August 14]], 2019, Sumalee was announced to be reprising her role in the then-upcoming second season of ''Star Wars Resistance'' in a [https://web.archive.org/web/20200527060644/https://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-resistance-season-2-trailer StarWars.com article] for the season's trailer.{{SW|url=news/star-wars-resistance-season-2-trailer|text=''Star Wars Resistance'' Season Two Trailer Revealed}} The second season's first episode, "[[Into the Unknown]]," premiered on [[April 15]], 2019, at Celebration Chicago,{{SW|url=news/swcc-2019-6-highlights-from-the-star-wars-resistance-panel|text=SWCC 2019: 6 Things We Learned from the ''Star Wars Resistance'' Panel|nolive=1}} and later debuted on television on [[October 6]], 2019. In an interview, Montano noted that working on ''Star Wars Resistance'' meant a lot to her and that being involved in a franchise so universally loved made the experience unique, as each voice actor would be equally excited about the project. She felt that collaborating on the animated show as Tierny was notably different than her experiences working on ''Star Wars'' video games, as the cast often recorded together, and especially commended [[Mary Elizabeth McGlynn]] for her work as voice director and Xiono's actor [[Christopher Sean]] for binding the cast together as a team. Sean and Ace pilot [[Torra Doza]]'s actor—[[Myrna Velasco]]—agreed with the sentiment, praising Montano's ability to change from a friendly demeanor to cold and manipulating while recording as Tierny with them.{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars Resistance: Complete Season One|episode=No Escape: Part 1}} Montano especially appreciated the writers' work in developing Ryvora's story arc and Tierny's role in it, finding great happiness in that two women of color formed a relationship on screen, which added diversity and representation. The actor was stunned speechless the first time she saw Tierny in animated form during a recording session, much to the rest of the cast's amusement. Montano enjoyed Tierny's role as a villain in pushing Ryvora toward the First Order, having loved the inherent struggle between the [[Light side of the Force|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force|dark]] sides of the Force as a fan. Montano also felt that her character's deep belief that she was not evil made her a much better villain for the show and personally related to the agent's backstory, also enjoying how Tierny's name seemed to be a play on the word "tyranny." While working on ''Star Wars Resistance'', she and Pyre's actor, [[Liam McIntyre]], worked on developing their offscreen chemistry so that their portrayal as onscreen First Order rivals would be smoother. Montano's favorite ''Resistance'' scene was from the "The Escape" as Tierny and Pyre were forced to turn their blasters on each other, noting that she enjoyed recording it with McIntyre. ''Star Wars Resistance''{{'s}} head writer [[Brandon Auman]] said that the conflict felt by Ryvora as she got sucked in by Tierny in "No Escape" was very emotional for him to watch, even years after the show's release.{{YouTube|channel=@FriendsOfTheForce|link=Friends of the Force|video=iyB_0nfiD3Q|text=Interview with Brandon Auman - Executive Producer & Head Writer on "Star Wars Resistance"|date=2021-08-29}} ===Production=== {{Quote|She's a security agent like Kallus, and they get to design their own gear. They don't really have the standard uniform, so her entire under suit is very police/SWAT team inspired.|Amy Beth Christenson, on Tierny's design|}} [[File:Tierny-ConceptArt6.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Concept artwork of Tierny by Jason Pichon]] [[Lucasfilm Animation]] artist [[Jason Pichon]] created a concept-art illustration of Tierny on [[September 27]], [[2017]]. [[Colas Gauthier]]—another Lucasfilm Animation artist—made a concept-art illustration of her blasters dated to the [[September 28|following day]].{{SW|url=news/cosplay-command-center-resistance|text=Cosplay Command Center, Part 1: Dressing the ''Resistance'' for ''Star Wars'' Celebration Chicago}} {{C|[https://web.archive.org/web/20230606081728/https://lumiere-a.akamaihd.net/v1/documents/tierny-cosplay-reference-swcom_59c788b3.pdf Tierny PDF]}} For the season two episode "[[Rebuilding the Resistance]]," Gauthier completed two pieces of concept artwork for Tierny's office aboard the ''Thunderer'' and for the weapons displayed in the room's wall cases, both dated to [[September 20]], [[2018]]. The agent's costume design was based on real-world riot police gear, such as those worn by the [[Wikipedia:United States|United States']] [[Wikipedia:SWAT|SWAT teams]], as well as [[Wikipedia:United States Navy SEALs|Navy SEAL]] garments. Additionally, the training garments of Navy SEALs influenced the knee padding and ribbing of Tierny's military-style sweater. Her helmet's style was based off of ones worn by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and [[Imperial Security Bureau]] Agent [[Alexsandr Kallus]]. Christenson theorized that Tierny's shoulder armor could have been repainted from parts of a First Order trooper's kit as part of the agent's customization of her uniform choices. The art director also felt that the agent's hairstyle was drawn simply, probably reflecting that she had a number of naturally lush locks. Tierny's office was designed to include a collection of weapons displayed in cases, which Christenson contrasted to the decorative art collection maintained by [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] "Thrawn" as shown in the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.{{BucketsList|fL3IGOQd7yc|"Rebuilding the Resistance"}} ===Scripting changes=== {{Quote|Agent Tierny's reaction to Kaz and Yeager's plan was deliberately worded so that she wouldn't repeat an iconic ''Star Wars'' catchphrase. Sorry, Tierny. That quote belongs to Admiral Ackbar.|Bucket's List|audio=TiernyItsASetup-BucketsList.flac|{{BucketsList|jd2IPIxEy70|"The Escape, Part 1 & 2"}}}} [[File:ItsATrap-TheShadowSyndicate.jpg|thumb|left|230px|One of Tierny's lines was intentionally scripted to not copy an infamous line of Admiral Ackbar's (pictured).]] The original outline of "Descent" did not include Tierny and instead had Pyre arresting and questioning Ryvora. By the first draft of the episode's script, Pyre was replaced by an "[[Admiral]] Tierny," and by the next script version, she had been redefined as a security agent from the First Order Security Bureau. The division was originally developed for the ''[[Star Wars: Poe Dameron]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic-book]] series as the First Order's version of the Imperial Security Bureau.{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-descent-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 7 Fun Facts from "Descent" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} In the early development of the episode "Rebuilding the Resistance," the conversation between Ryvora and Tierny would have been the episode's opener as a teaser. However, by the final iteration of the episode, Venisa Doza's arrival at the ''Colossus'' is instead shown first to better set up the mission and plot. In "The Escape: Part 1," Tierny realizes that Yeager and Xiono rigged their shuttle to explode and indicates to her troopers that the situation is a setup. The StarWars.com article "Bucket's List Extra: 5 Fun Facts from "The Escape - Part 1" - ''Star Wars Resistance''" revealed that her reaction was intentionally worded to not copy the iconic ''Star Wars'' catchphrase "It's a trap!," which was introduced to the franchise in{{SW|url=news/buckets-list-extra-the-escape-part-1-star-wars-resistance|text=Bucket's List Extra: 5 Fun Facts from "The Escape - Part 1" - ''Star Wars Resistance''}} the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film{{Film|VI}} [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], said by Admiral [[Gial Ackbar]]. In the draft scripts sent to actors for auditions for ''Star Wars Resistance'', Tierny's name was listed different from its final iteration, which her voice actor Montano suspected was done to hide her identity. ===Development=== {{Quote|…we're not sure exactly if Tierny is lying about her past… […] Was she struggling or was she just trying to figure out a way to get in there with Tam—knowing Tam, the psychology of Tam and trying to figure out what makes her relatable to Tam. You know ''[sic]'' we kind of kept her purposefully mysterious so that you're not quite sure you know what her deal is.|Brandon Auman|audio=Tierny-BrandonAuman.flac|}} [[File:BrandonAuman.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Brandon Auman (pictured) was involved in Tierny's character development for ''Star Wars Resistance''.]] Discussions about including more of Tierny's background were held during the production of ''Star Wars Resistance''. However, in an interview, Auman noted that they intentionally kept her origins mysterious and undefined. He further alluded that while she may have lied to Ryvora about her background as a manipulation tactic, he personally felt Tierny had been truthful. Auman mused that her familial relations, if any, may have been negatively affected by the Empire's [[Galactic Concordance|fall]], leading Tierny to try to work through the New Republic before eventually leaving to join the First Order—formed from the [[Imperial Remnants|remains]] of the Empire—after remembering her family's Imperial connections. The showrunner indicated that he imagined many of the First Order characters likely came from tragic backgrounds in some form and joined the First Order after seeing the New Republic's flaws. Auman indicated that Tierny and Pyre were, to some degree, equals—primarily because the former had been given a lot of power after some of Pyre's mistakes. The showrunner felt that the scene in which the pair were forced to aim their blasters at each other by Kylo Ren was one of the darkest parts of ''Star Wars Resistance'', noting that Pyre often
